 Introduction 
 Dom 
This is Dom Cooke. And today, we're breaking down Harvard Business Publishing. The media arm of Harvard's world-famous business schools founded in the early '90s, but the seeds were sown a century ago in 1922, when the first edition of the Harvard Business Review was printed. 100 years on this secretive business has been through significant change, but the routes of influencing managers through academic research remains firmly intact. And despite its not-for-profit status, Harvard Business Publishing generates an impressive and growing income stream for its parent institution.

 To explore the business, I'm joined by our Colossus CEO, Matt Reustle. Please enjoy this breakdown of Harvard Business Publishing.

 History of Harvard's Publishing Arm 
 Dom 
Matt, welcome. We're talking about Harvard Business Publishing today. And I think there's only one place to start, and that's why we're talking about this business.
